nodes.label: FSI-SPH demo programs (DamBreak, WaveTank, flexible-body suite)
nodes.rationale: The flexible-body FSI demos (Flexible_Plate, Flexible_Cable, Flexible_Toroidal_Tire, FEAdirections) are gated on FEA *and* PARDISO_MKL together, because deformable solids coupled to SPH need a direct sparse solver for the structural side; demo_FSI-SPH_BCE is VSG-only since it exists to visualize boundary-condition-enforcing marker layouts.
